description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifically for a consumer of multiple stream subscriptions. It declares methods for managing stream subscriptions such as becoming a consumer, resuming, stopping, retrieving all subscriptions, and getting consumption statistics.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a consumer to a specified stream using the provided stream ID, namespace, and provider. Returns a handle to the created subscription.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a previously paused or inactive stream subscription using the subscription handle.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all active stream subscription handles for a given stream identified by ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping each subscription handle to a tuple representing the number of items consumed.
